verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a general Quo API exists, but nothing documents API endpoints for sending or receiving SMS. There is also no evidence of registrable webhooks or delivery-status callbacks. The texting and message-history capabilities appear only in the no-code MCP/agent integration, which is a different feature and does not count toward this API-plus-callbacks story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive SMS on the number through the API with delivery status callbacks
